theory.body: Linear Regression Basics describes the methods and patterns used within Data Science to achieve reliable, maintainable results. Understanding it is the foundation for everything built later in this course.

theory.body: Without Linear Regression Basics, systems built with Data Science are harder to debug, extend and operate. Teams that master this topic ship fewer defects and communicate more clearly about design decisions.

theory.body: The mechanism behind Linear Regression Basics follows a repeatable sequence: understand the requirement, apply the principle, verify the result and refine based on feedback. Each step has checks that keep the work on track.

theory.body: Linear Regression Basics offers structure, clarity and consistency, but it also adds overhead and may be overkill for trivial tasks. Use it when the benefit in reliability outweighs the added effort.
